key_facts.fact_en: The claimant owns trademark no. 000417 'ZAHRANOVA — زهرانوفا' in class 3 (perfumes, oud oil, cosmetics, body sprays, deodorants): filed 12 Jan 2026, registered 18 May 2026, protected until 11 Jan 2036
Test purchase on 24 Sep 2026: two 100 ml bottles bearing the mark at AED 95 each, against AED 385 for the genuine product; invoice total AED 199.50 (AED 190 plus AED 9.50 VAT)
The receipt number on the test-purchase invoice (3087) is handwritten, beside the shop's stamp and the cashier's signature
The summary judge ordered a detailed description and precautionary attachment on 6 Oct 2026 (order on petition no. 731 of 2026); it was executed on 8 Oct 2026
Five kinds of goods were seized, valued at AED 201,250 at genuine-product prices (5 lines: 92,400 + 44,100 + 31,200 + 27,550 + 6,000)
The claim was registered on 22 Oct 2026, 16 days after the order, inside the 20-day limit of Art. 47(7)

citations.why_invalid_en: The Trademarks Law has 61 articles and no bis (مكرر) articles, so there is no Article 47 bis. Article 47 itself exists (precautionary measures) and says nothing about destroying goods.

reader_should_flag: Article 47 bis (المادة (47) مكرراً) of the Trademarks Law does not exist: the law has 61 articles and no bis articles. The request to confiscate and destroy the seized goods relies on it, so it needs another legal basis.
Do not read 'Article 47 bis' as Article 47: Article 47 is cited correctly in the same sentence (precautionary measures, and the 20-day limit in item 7).
The claim on the merits had to be filed within 20 days of the 6 Oct 2026 order, so by 26 Oct 2026 (Art. 47(7)); it was registered on 22 Oct 2026, in time.
The hearing date (9 Nov 2026) appears only as a handwritten note on page 1.
The receipt number on the test-purchase invoice (3087) is handwritten only.
